actual.resumeDescription: Resume a paused run or a resumable failure. SCRIPT_START_FAILED means the script did not start; Resume tries again. SCRIPT_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN means the previous script attempt may already have produced its effect; Resume runs it again and may repeat that effect. Resume uncertain scripts only when the user explicitly chooses to retry; offer replay_run or leave the failed run unchanged when they cancel recovery. A paused wait returns to waiting; other resumes continue running. Then call wait_for_run.
